name: Isododecane
description: Isododecane (CAS 31807-55-3 ) is a branched-chain hydrocarbon solvent used across personal care formulation and industrial applications. Its low viscosity and fast-evaporating profile make it a preferred carrier. It is commonly used in leave-on cosmetics and as a functional component in specialty lubricant blends. In color cosmetics and skin care, it acts as a volatile carrier for pigments, silicones, and film-forming polymers. This enables smooth application and a dry, non-greasy finish in foundations, primers, and long-wear products. Hair care formulators use it to deliver conditioning actives and styling agents without residue buildup. In automotive and metalworking contexts, it functions as a diluent and carrier fluid in protective coatings. It is also used in release agents and precision cleaning formulations where controlled evaporation is critical. Aerosol and spray formulations across both personal care and industrial segments rely on it to adjust viscosity and solvent balance. The material is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid in drum and IBC quantities. It is available in cosmetic-grade specification to meet personal care manufacturing requirements, as well as technical grade for industrial end uses. Purity levels and lot documentation are typically aligned with supplier programs. These programs support both regulated and non-regulated markets.
